related.description: zsh plugin allowing you to switch brew installations depending on the arch specified
Use bruse to switch versions of things you have installed via homebrew, e.g. bruse php 7.4 or bruse node 10.
This zsh plugin will read `.valetphprc` from the project root and will switch to that PHP version automatically real time
The easy way to switch between your projects on ZSH
An oh-my-zsh tool plugin to switch different host modes.
